title: Keyword search vs. vector search
intro: The same query, run twice against the same catalogue. On the left, the keyword engine matches words. On the right, vector search matches meaning — it compares the embedding of your query with the embedding of every product, so it can answer a request whose words appear nowhere in the catalogue.

keyword.title: Keyword search
keyword.emptyBody: Not one product contains these words. There is no spelling mistake to correct and no synonym configured, so the keyword engine has nothing to match on — the shopper hits a dead end.
